When accessing fields from a data structure that could be either a pandas DataFrame or a list of dictionaries, ensure you handle the iteration or indexing consistently to avoid passing a list where a single datetime object is expected.
Do not call .tolist() on an object that is already a Python list; use it only on NumPy arrays to convert them to lists.
